reviews.title: Clean stable air cooler friendly memory.
reviews.comment: For AM5 builds Ram is always a scary thing to buy. So far this Ram has been really stable. Also its one of the few air cooler friendly ram kits. I also love how it has no rgb for my specific build. Im running a 9800x3d on msi x870e board.
reviews.author: Miltronicus

reviews.title: hynix m die - overclocking monster
reviews.comment: Clocks to almost any speed you want it to run at, can run at much lower timings than advertised. I couldnt be happier with it. I run it at 1.27v and tighter timings than advertised :)
reviews.author: Walter
